ops.oldText: The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor.
ops.newText: The Agreement may be renewed for successive additional periods of twelve (12) months only by mutual written agreement of the parties, and any increase in fees for a renewal period shall not exceed the lesser of the increase in the Consumer Price Index over the preceding period and three percent (3%).

input.comment: [Playbook] We replaced the Licensor's unilateral seven-year renewal option with twelve-month renewals by mutual written agreement and a CPI/3% cap on renewal fee increases, consistent with the rest of Article IV, which already provides that extensions are by mutual written agreement. Our playbook does not accept multi-year renewals that we cannot exit; we can discuss a 12-month auto-renewal with a 30-day opt-out as an alternative.
input.summary: Renewal limited to 12 months by mutual agreement with capped uplift
